brief.analysis: raw_and_detrended_diverge is true — detrended z of 0.59 against raw 1.65 is direct evidence the ratio's own mean is drifting upward, not that price is stretched above a stable mean. That drift is backed by a genuine defense-spending regime: ITA rose ~48% in 2025 on rising global budgets and is near all-time highs, while the quant flags slope not confirmed and base_rate is only 3/6. The flat 5-year mean has moved beneath the trend and is not a valid target.
brief.report_line: Declining the ITA/SPY short: the detrended-versus-raw divergence and a structural defense-budget cycle show the mean is drifting up, so the 5-year target is stale rather than a dislocation.

brief.analysis: The 5-year mean target (+77.8%) was set before the AI capex buildout that has turned semiconductors from a cyclical group into the market's highest-beta vehicle, with hyperscaler capex guided above $400B for 2026 versus ~$230B in 2024. Shorting SMH/QQQ toward that pre-regime mean is fighting the dominant structural bid; the quant only has this on watchlist (ma_score 0/3, slope intact), confirming no reversion is underway. The old flat mean is an invalid target and the 3-sigma reading is a trap.
brief.report_line: Passing on the SMH/QQQ short: the +78% pull to the 5-year mean assumes a pre-AI-capex world, and the structural semiconductor bid makes that mean an invalid target rather than a rubber band.

brief.analysis: The strongest reversion case is that ma_score is 3/3, the 50DMA has turned, and the 200DMA target is already achieved with z back to 0.99 — most of the move is done. But a short SLV/GLD bets gold outperforms silver just as silver has broken above multi-year resistance into price-discovery on a fifth straight structural deficit, so the remaining leg to the deeper 5-year mean fights a live regime. The mean may still be valid but the easy money is booked; carry only a reduced position.
brief.report_line: Holding a size-down SLV/GLD short after the 200DMA target hit, with the key risk that silver's structural deficit and breakout keep the ratio from reaching the deeper 5-year mean.

brief.analysis: Reversion mechanics are clean — ma_score 3/3, slope turned, 200DMA achieved, base_rate 2/2, and detrended_z 0.03 versus raw 0.80 shows no mean-drift, so the statistics are not a trap. The offsetting risk is that XME nearly doubled on a live gold-and-copper regime tied to electrification, defense, and monetary uncertainty, and the only remaining target is the deeper 5-year mean. Tradeable toward that mean but size down, since the commodity regime can re-stretch the ratio against a short.
brief.report_line: Carrying a reduced XME/SPY short toward the 5-year mean — trend and mean agree (detrended z ~0), but a still-hot gold/copper commodity regime is the reason to keep size below full.
